events.text: DESIGN RULING for T1 (modeling stage, req_2618 gap A): the stage grid is NOT decoration — it is GAME TILE SPACE rendered under the mesh. Each of the 9 coarse panels = exactly 1 game tile (1 tile = 1 m = 16 u, the same basis the Add Shape dialog and studio scale line declare: '16 u = 1 tile = 1 m'). The center panel's finer sub-grid exists specifically to read SUB-TILE scale while editing (16 subdivisions = 1 u each). So the grid doubles as the scale/direction reference the user flagged missing: a wall part visibly spanning one panel IS one tile wide in the world, the mannequin (1.65m) reads against it, backdrops size in the same meters ('1 m = 1 tile' in the backdrop dialog). Implementation constraint: build the stage in gpu/3d.zig in world units off the same 16u basis constant the mesh ops use — not an arbitrary cosmetic grid; center 3x3m fine cell at 1u pitch, coarse lines at 1m (tile) pitch. This makes model-editor space and world-editor tile space the SAME space, which is why the old editor's models dropped into the map at correct scale with zero fitting.
